verdict.rationale: Granola documents a native HubSpot integration. Notes added to Granola folders are saved automatically to the relevant HubSpot contacts, companies or deals, which covers the core of the story for HubSpot. Salesforce and Attio have no documented native sync and could only be reached through Zapier or a custom build on the Granola API, which means extra tooling. Missing for 10: native Salesforce and Attio sync, matching to the right record without manual folder filing, independent or hands-on confirmation that the HubSpot sync works.
